notes.title: Mars Underground Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Patch 1.01 Notes

This patch mainly addresses issues the community have raised.

Fixes:
-Potential crash at Moloch Media
-Police not visible in police station at early night
-Robe dissapearing in CPA room
-Made some achievements easier to get
-Fixed several graphic glitches
-Slowed down some stuff post game
